The single no answers to both כָּל and לֹא, which share one discontinuous unit headed on the negative under rules 30 and 35 — the word carries every morpheme's sense, so nothing is left over to mark, and distance does not break the fusion. The competing reading (no to כֹּל alone, לֹא unrepresented) is named in the unit note.
הָיָה takes the presentative there with its copula under rule 21, and both infinitive suffixes take their subject pronouns under rule 18.
